page.overview:
What is Technopathy?

Technopathy was the ability to manipulate technology with the mind. Immortal Rur, a functioning A.I. copy of a long-dead Jedi named Rur, was in fact a powerful technopath. as did the Order of the Sight Voltaic. Lony Coleema belonged to a species who possessed the ability of technopathy.
